Name: Pan Hat Slot - Cover Up Ugly Pans
Author: Malkavian242
Description:
I never really used pans because I value my inventory slots too much. Then I found out you can equip the pan on your head as a hat, but it looks so ugly... So I made this mod, which adds a new attachment slot to pans so you can customize how they look on your head, preserving enchantments and upgrades.

[b]REQUIRES [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SPACE CORE
[/url][/b]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
Have a hat and your pan in your inventory. Grab the hat with left click and attach it to the pan with right click, like how you would attach bait to a fishing rod.

Now when you equip the pan on your head, it will look like the hat you attached.

Unequip your hat and you'll get the pan back. You can detach the hat from the pan using right click again.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/26741/26741-1722859565-2141839675.gif[/img]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
Tested in 1.6 single and multiplayer. Let me know if there are any issues!
I did the most I could so it doesn't conflict with mods which add enchantments and data to pans and hats, but there could be problems, beware!
Might also not work with mods which replace the inventory page.
